limits: Public QASPER selected text-locatable subset; SciFact official-dev Gold as held-out Final, not leaderboard test.
Single seed 11; public pretraining exposure unknown; no independent human citation support review.
Final failure outcomes retained in fixed denominators; insufficient_evidence reported separately.
Original cache-on/cache-off Dev efficiency remains stratified, never a matched latency improvement claim.
Unknown usage is not zero; reported partial tokens are separated from known-complete usage.
Warm task latency includes worker startup/corpus preparation/native token RPC; cold load is separate.
Evidence count-based metrics are frozen benchmark proxies, not human citation accuracy.
No post-Final model, Prompt, parameter, scorer, Gold or strategy selection.

measurement_rules.bootstrap: paired source-document connected clusters; 2000 draws, seed20261009, nearest-rank 2.5%/97.5% percentiles: ceil(p*n)-1, no interpolation (2000 draws: indices49/1949); no p-values
measurement_rules.p95: nearest rank ceil(0.95*n), known values only
